The '''11th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', were held in [[Santa Monica]], [[California]] at the Club Del Mar honoring the best in [[film]] for [[1953 in film|1953]] films, on January 22, 1954.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Collections {{!}} Japanese American National Museum |url=https://www.janm.org/collections |access-date=2024-03-07 |website=www.janm.org}}</ref>

==Winners==

''' ''[[The Robe (film)|The Robe]] directed by [[Henry Koster]]''<ref>{{Cite web |title=Best Motion Picture Drama |url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1953 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415111802/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1953 |archive-date=2012-04-15 |access-date=2024-09-02}}</ref>'''
